name: Kali Gayatri
text:
ॐ महाकाल्यै विद्महे श्मशानवासिन्यै धीमहि ।
तन्नो अघोरा प्रचोदयात् ॥
meaning: We meditate on Maha Kali, who dwells in the cremation ground. May the fierce one guide us towards the ultimate truth.
note: It contains cremation-ground imagery and should be approached with appropriate guidance. Gayatri wording varies; this is the client list’s.
